title: Three-Way Pronoun Matrix: Interior vs Surface

sections.content:
Compare how personal pronouns parallel the noun case trios:
- **Inessive (inside)**: *bennem, benned, benne...* (in me/you/him)
- **Superessive (on the surface)**: *rajtam, rajtad, rajta...* (on me/you/him)
- **Sublative (onto the surface / directed)**: *rám, rád, rá...* (towards/at me/you/him)

items.spanish: Bízom benned (in you), és számítok rád (on you).
items.english: I trust in you, and I count on you.

items.spanish: Rajtam múlik a siker, de benned van az erő.
items.english: The success depends on me, but the strength is in you.
